boxes.text: This module defines four separate frequency bands using three numbers to represent the division points. The peak amplitude for input falling into the specified frequency ranges is output as Vizzie data in the range 0. - 1.0.
Click on the ezdac~ to turn on the audio
An integer 1 or 0 in the left inlet enables or disables the module. A disabled module passes video through

boxes.comment: Set the boundary used for dividing low range from low/mid frequency range
Set the boundary used for dividing mid/high range from high frequency range
Set the boundary used for dividing low/mid range from mid/high frequency range

boxes.text: A Vizzie module/abstraction that generates data by analyzing audio input
Mouse over the dots to see what a data inlet controls
